title: Technology Specialist
description:
**Company Description**
Amigosia Pvt Ltd is a growing organization focused on delivering technology-driven solutions to support modern business needs. Amigosia emphasizes continuous learning and encourages employees to explore new tools and methodologies. The organization is committed to maintaining an inclusive and respectful workplace. Joining Amigosia offers opportunities to work with diverse technologies and contribute to scalable, practical solutions.

Job Description – Technical Specialist (Finance & Procurement)

**Experience:**
10+ Years

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**Job Level:**
Senior / Specialist

**Industry:**
Software Development / Enterprise Applications

**Preferred Domain Experience:**
Finance, Procurement, Real Estate / Property Management

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Technical Specialist with over 10 years of experience in the software industry and strong domain knowledge in Finance and Procurement. The ideal candidate should have a deep understanding of business processes, functional workflows, and technical implementations across financial management and procurement systems.

The candidate will be responsible for understanding business requirements, translating them into technical and functional specifications, guiding development teams, and ensuring the successful implementation of enterprise software solutions.

Experience in Real Estate, Property Management, Facility Management, or Construction Management software will be an added advantage.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Domain & Functional Expertise**

* Demonstrate strong functional knowledge of Finance, Accounting, Procurement, and Vendor Management processes.
* Understand financial workflows, including Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, General Ledger, Budgeting, Invoicing, Taxation, and Financial Reporting.
* Understand procurement workflows, including Purchase Requests, Purchase Orders, Vendor Management, Quotations, Approvals, Goods/Service Receipts, and Payments.
* Analyse business processes and identify opportunities for automation and process optimization.

**2. Technical & Solution Design**

* Translate business requirements into functional specifications, technical documentation, and system workflows.
* Work closely with software architects, developers, UI/UX designers, and QA teams.
* Define system architecture requirements, integrations, APIs, and data flows for finance and procurement modules.
* Review technical solutions to ensure they align with business requirements and industry standards.
* Provide technical guidance and domain expertise throughout the software development lifecycle.

**3. Project Implementation & Client Engagement**

* Interact with clients and stakeholders to understand business requirements and operational challenges.
* Participate in requirement gathering, business process mapping, solution design, and implementation.
* Support UAT, system validation, deployment, and post-implementation activities.
* Coordinate with development teams to ensure timely and quality delivery.

**4. Real Estate / Property Management Domain (Preferred)**

* Knowledge of real estate financial operations, property accounting, and project cost management.
* Understanding of lease management, rental billing, maintenance expenses, vendor contracts, and facility management.
* Familiarity with property management systems, construction procurement, project budgeting, and financial tracking.
* Experience developing or implementing ERP, CRM, or property management solutions will be an advantage.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* 10+ years of experience in the software industry.
* Strong domain expertise in Finance, Accounting, and Procurement.
* Experience working on ERP, Financial Management Systems, Procurement Platforms, or Enterprise Applications.
* Ability to understand complex business requirements and convert them into software solutions.
* Experience in functional requirement documentation, workflow design, and system integration.
* Good understanding of APIs, databases, software architecture, and enterprise application development.
* Strong analytical, communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.
* Experience working with cross-functional development teams.

Preferred Experience

* Experience in Real Estate, Property Management, Facility Management, or Construction Management software.
* Experience with ERP platforms such as SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, or similar enterprise systems.
* Exposure to financial automation, procurement automation, and workflow management platforms.
* Experience in client-facing technical consulting or solution architecture roles.

Key Expectations

* The candidate should be capable of acting as a domain and technical bridge between business stakeholders and software development teams, ensuring that complex Finance and Procurement business requirements are translated into scalable, practical, and user-friendly software solutions.

title: Lead AI / Agentic Platform Architect
description:
We are looking for an experienced
**Lead AI / Agentic Platform Architect**
with strong hands-on expertise in designing, architecting, and engineering LLM-powered and agentic AI solutions.

The candidate should also be comfortable working in the
**US EST time zone**
to ensure close collaboration with the client team. The ideal candidate should have practical experience building and orchestrating AI agents, integrating LLMs, designing agent runtimes, implementing tool integrations, and establishing scalable, secure, and governed AI platforms. This role requires someone who can evaluate existing agentic AI architectures, understand platform dependencies, define technical standards, establish evaluation frameworks, and identify gaps in safety, security, and AI governance. The candidate should be equally comfortable with architecture-level decisions and hands-on technical implementation.

**Work Schedule:**
Must be flexible and willing to work in the US Eastern Standard Time (EST) time zone.

**Responsibilities include:**

**Agentic AI Architecture & Platform Engineering**

* Design and architect scalable, enterprise-grade agentic AI platforms and solutions.
* Define agent orchestration patterns, runtime architecture, workflows, and multi-agent communication mechanisms.
* Architect prompt engineering frameworks, tool calling, connectors, and model integration strategies.
* Design memory management, state persistence, and context management mechanisms.
* Evaluate and implement RAG architectures and vector database integrations wherever applicable.

**LLM & AI Integration**

* Design and integrate LLM-based applications using leading commercial and open-source models.
* Establish model integration patterns, routing, fallback mechanisms, and model selection strategies.
* Define reusable components and frameworks for agent development and deployment.
* Optimize model performance, latency, scalability, and token consumption.

**AI Evaluation, Monitoring & Observability**

* Define evaluation frameworks to measure agent accuracy, reliability, consistency, and performance.
* Establish mechanisms for testing prompts, tools, workflows, and end-to-end agent behaviour.
* Implement telemetry, monitoring, tracing, and observability for agentic systems.
* Define mechanisms to identify hallucinations, failures, and performance bottlenecks.

**AI Safety, Security & Governance**

* Identify and address security and governance gaps in agentic AI architectures.
* Establish guardrails for responsible AI implementation, including access controls and data protection.
* Define policies for tool permissions, human-in-the-loop controls, and agent execution boundaries.
* Ensure appropriate compliance, auditability, and governance standards are incorporated into the architecture.

**Technical Leadership & Architecture Assessment**

* Assess existing AI and agentic platform architectures and map technical dependencies.
* Identify architecture gaps, integration challenges, scalability risks, and opportunities for improvement.
* Recommend target-state architecture and implementation roadmaps.
* Collaborate with engineering, product, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into technical solutions.
* Provide technical guidance and architectural direction to engineering teams.

Primary Skills :

* 5+ years of experience in software architecture, AI engineering, platform engineering, or related technical roles, including recent hands-on experience building LLM-powered and agentic AI systems.
* Strong understanding of agent orchestration frameworks, agent runtimes, multi-agent systems, and workflow automation.
* Hands-on experience with LLM integrations, prompt engineering, function calling, and tool orchestration.
* Experience designing memory, state management, context handling, and RAG-based architectures.
* Knowledge of vector databases, embeddings, semantic search, and retrieval mechanisms.
* Experience implementing AI guardrails, evaluation frameworks, and observability solutions.
* Strong understanding of AI security, governance, data privacy, and responsible AI principles.
* Ability to assess complex architectures, identify dependencies, and recommend scalable technical solutions.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

Secondary Skills :

* Experience with frameworks and platforms such as LangChain, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, CrewAI, or equivalent.
* Exposure to cloud-based AI ecosystems such as Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, or Google Vertex AI.
* Experience with vector databases such as Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant, or Azure AI Search.
* Familiarity with agent evaluation tools, tracing, and monitoring frameworks.
* Experience designing enterprise AI platforms with security, scalability, and cost optimization considerations.

title: Manager, Platform Software Engineering
description:
**Job Description**
Manages a platform team’s operational outcomes; provides technical/functional leadership for shared services, SDKs, and integration frameworks. Ensures adherence to compatibility, rollout, and security standards; resolves moderately complex cross-service issues. Guides team-level observability, capacity planning, and resilience improvements. Communicates scope and trade-offs to related teams; tracks platform adoption and developer experience within the team’s remit.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Key Responsibilities**
**Platform Software Development:**

* Operate a platform team roadmap that enforces compatibility, versioning, and safe rollout policies for shared services and SDKs.
* Drive team-level observability baselines (SLOs, error budgets) and resilience patterns; ensure adherence during releases.
* Coordinate cross-team incident response for platform issues, ensuring downstream consumer safety and clear remediation paths.

**Software Development and Coding - Design, Testing, and Optimization:**

* Manages team and may contribute to the design and development of code and software solutions and identifies and analyzes requirements.
* Provides coaching and process execution for team to develop and guide new software features and enhancements following design specifications, ensuring accessibility, and to develop documents to clarify software design and code.
* Leads code reviews to drive improvements.
* Leads and reviews team to conduct debugging and troubleshooting to identify and fix software issues within a single component or functional area.
* Ensures team implements software testing (e.g., functional and non-functional), quality assurance processes, software error logging, monitoring, and observability for effective debugging.
* Leverages prior experience and analysis to conduct performance profiling and optimization of coding.
* Guides team in troubleshooting and resolving issues related to application programming interface (API) functionality and integration.
* Manages team to implement API versioning, lifecycle, and interoperability strategies.

**Software Architecture - Software System Structural Design:**

* Manages team to design and develop software, systems, and services.
* Provides technical leadership and technical guidance and domain expertise in software architecture decisions and best practices.
* Guides team and conducts periodic reviews and ensures adherence to architectural framework(s) and internal development practices and standards.
* Collaborates with stakeholders within own group to align and build software architecture with business and/or customer goals and priorities
* Implements performance optimization and scalability strategies in software design.
* Impacts immediate team to conduct regular technology research and evaluation for architectural enhancements.

**Issue/Defect Collaboration - Software Products Support:**

* May collaborate and communicate with stakeholders to understand customer issues and align solutions.
* Manages team to provide technical guidance and appropriately prioritize support to customers regarding reported issues.
* Enables direct reports to advocate for customers' interests and suggests product enhancements based on feedback.
* Communicates regularly with stakeholders to ensure customer satisfaction through timely resolution of issues and effective communication.
* Provides guidance to team on processes for handling customer issues and/or defects and directs them to training opportunities as needed.
* Investigates and troubleshoots product maintenance issues to ensure customer agreement on short- and long-term solutions.

**Practices and Standards Compliance - Security and Compliance:**

* Collaborates with the team and other stakeholders to establish, follow, and enforce documented security criteria, development industry best practices and processes, and coding standards.
* Ensures team adherence to broad acceptance criteria.
* Implements moderately complex secure software development practices to prevent security vulnerabilities.

**Development Operations - System Maintenance:**

* Manages team to perform periodic maintenance and testing operations for systems that require upgrading or patching for (e.g., for critical vulnerabilities).
* Guides team to follow standard operating procedures (SOP) for development and drive improvements, ensuring automation, testing, and debugging of systems to ensure service/product availability, health, support, and reliability.

**Core Responsibilities**
**Planning & Execution:**

* Creates and owns the execution plan for the team's work and multiple projects or initiatives, monitoring timelines and budgets when applicable to ensure projects are completed on time and in adherence with requirements. Delegates work across the team and helps them prioritize their work. Identifies resource needs and adapts plans based on changing priorities and business needs.

**Collaboration & Partnership:**

* Strengthens collaborative partnerships across teams to align expectations and shared objectives. Guides team members to build relationships with business leaders, stakeholders, and/or customers to ensure effective collaboration. Practices active listening and asks insightful questions to promote an inclusive culture.

**Problem Solving:**

* Leads team to identify and address moderately complex operational and/or technical issues in accordance with standard practices, providing guidance as appropriate. Directs team to analyze data and/or information from multiple sources to troubleshoot moderately complex errors.

**Continuous Learning:**

* Actively seeks learning opportunities for self and team to enhance knowledge and skills in key areas and remain current with industry advancements. Uses feedback and training to elevate personal and team skills, modeling a commitment to learning. Identifies skill gaps within the team and supports team members in learning opportunities by providing resources and fostering an environment that encourages knowledge-sharing.

**Continuous Improvement:**

* Identifies and recommends improvements as well as encourages team to share ideas to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows within a team. Reviews and provides feedback on team members’ ideas and seeks input from others on alternative approaches and methods for improving work.

**Performance and Development:**

* Coaches and provides direction to team members in alignment with performance management processes, guidelines, and expectations. Facilitates goal setting discussions with team members, ensuring individual goals are aligned with broader team goals. Identifies development opportunities to help team members improve performance. Contributes to the talent acquisition pipeline by leading candidate interviews, assessing promotion eligibility, and managing talent resources.
